source: Authenticated Apify session plus live Actor Store pricing tab
pricing_note: The page headline says 'from $2.40 / 1,000 videos'; the pricing table shows that rate under Business. The authenticated account is Free, so the applicable video rate is $4.00 / 1,000.
transcript_cost_behavior: ALWAYS_SUBTITLES downloads existing YouTube subtitles when present. TRANSCRIPTION_AS_FALLBACK and ALWAYS_TRANSCRIBE use paid speech-to-text and can trigger the transcript-minute event. This proposal enables existing subtitles only and disables paid transcription.
